extracted_information: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint supports diverse deployment, configuration, and reporting options, offering flexibility and granular control for varying customer requirements. Similar capabilities are provided by Defender for Business for small and medium-sized businesses.

items.name: Endpoint Onboarding
items.details: Fully integrated into Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Configuration Manager for client devices. Both client and server devices can be onboarded via the Microsoft Defender portal. Servers can also be onboarded using Defender for Cloud (requires server licenses).

items.name: Portal Access
items.details: The Microsoft Defender portal provides a robust, end-to-end experience for configuration, deployment, and monitoring. Supports Group Policy and other non-Microsoft tools for device management.

items.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
items.details: Provides fine-grained control over user permissions within the portal, supporting globally distributed organizations, tiered security operations teams, and segregated divisions with centralized global security operations teams.

items.name: Integration-Ready Platform
items.details: Defender for Endpoint exposes much of its data and actions through programmatic APIs, enabling workflow automation and innovation. These APIs are also usable with Defender for Business for supported capabilities.

items.name: API Categories
items.details: Grouped into three main types: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint APIs, Raw data streaming API, and SIEM integration.

sub_features.name: Layered API Model
sub_features.details: Exposes data and capabilities via a structured, clear, and easy-to-use model, with standard Azure AD-based authentication and authorization. Designed for consistent exposure of entities and capabilities.

sub_features.name: Investigation API
sub_features.details: Exposes calculated/profiled entities (device, user, file) and discrete events (process creation, file creation) describing entity behavior. Allows query-based access to data via investigation interfaces. Refer to 'Supported APIs'.

sub_features.name: Response API
sub_features.details: Enables actions within the service and on devices, including ingesting indicators, managing settings, alerting status, and programmatic response actions like isolating devices or quarantining files.

items.name: Raw Data Streaming API
items.details: Provides the ability to ship real-time events and alerts from instances as they occur in a single data stream, offering low latency and high throughput delivery. Event information can be pushed directly to Azure storage for long-term retention or to Azure Event Hubs for consumption by visualization services or data processing engines. The new Microsoft Defender XDR Streaming API includes email and alert events in addition to device events.

items.name: SIEM API
items.details: Enables pulling detections from Microsoft Defender XDR using SIEM solutions or direct connection to the detections REST API. Activating SIEM integration provides pre-populated access details and creates an application under the Microsoft Entra tenant.
